title: A fix after a passed fix check is recordable without a new chain or an owner grant
why: After #2992's fix check passed (8c837aa36), batch 115 found a 6-line test-only defect (fix f30500427, red then green). `merge --review-record --fix-check` refuses a second fix check, so the lane needs an owner round-4 grant or a fresh full chain.
source: lane ruled-store-one-home 21:20 CST and coordinator 21:21 CST Nov 12
note: Owner pick a on item fix-check-chain-cap (10:19 CST Nov 8): "a chain may hold two fix checks, then a fresh chain". Decision pr-review-record on main says "One fix verifier per record" (exception: a conflicted main merge after a PASS). Possible stale decision: the decision does not carry the Nov 8 pick, or a later ruling narrowed it. Lane reads the history first (rule outcomes-stale-decision-protocol), then either aligns the merge tool with the pick (red then green) or brings the gap. Meanwhile: owner item 675 grant-round4-2992.
